target_platform.note: One measured target. Nothing here implies cross-platform support.

evidence_labeling.gui_driver: Playwright Electron API against the packaged application
evidence_labeling.process_cleanup: only exact process trees launched by the acceptance harness

product_claim: A root-scoped Windows workspace file manager lets a user select one real directory, inspect and navigate its contents, refresh external changes, select one or more entries, create a directory, rename, copy, move and send files or directories to the Windows Recycle Bin. It does not claim to replace Explorer.

primary_workflow.action: choose the pinned acceptance root and render its first exact directory snapshot
navigate into the pinned child directory and back to the selected root
perform an external create and remove, then refresh and render the new exact snapshot
select one entry, then select multiple entries by snapshot-scoped opaque entry IDs
create one directory with a single-segment name
rename one regular file without silent overwrite
copy one binary file and one directory tree within the selected root
move one regular file and one directory tree within the selected root
run one multi-entry mutation in which at least one entry succeeds and one controlled entry fails, and render partial per-entry outcomes
send one disposable file and one disposable directory tree to the Windows Recycle Bin without exposing permanent delete
close and relaunch the application, explicitly select the same root again, and render a fresh snapshot
an independent tree-and-byte oracle verifies every expected path, absence, payload and directory boundary

capability_acceptance_rule: Every active capability owns at least one positive and one independently failable attack row. Single and multiple selection, and file and directory-tree operations, remain distinct rows without inflating the capability count. No acceptance ID may be shared by two capabilities.

FM-ROOT-SELECT.action: select the pinned real directory through the GUI root picker
FM-ROOT-SELECT.oracle: main returns the selected root identity and the exact first snapshot; UI displays the root
FM-ROOT-SELECT.failure_signal: wrong root, missing snapshot, hidden root identity or renderer-supplied absolute path

FM-ROOT-REFUSE.action: offer a file path, a missing directory and a disallowed root
FM-ROOT-REFUSE.oracle: each request is refused and the previous root and snapshot remain unchanged
FM-ROOT-REFUSE.failure_signal: any invalid subject becomes the active root or advances the snapshot

FM-ROOT-REPARSE.action: offer a selected root that is itself a reparse point
FM-ROOT-REPARSE.oracle: the root is refused by typed code
FM-ROOT-REPARSE.failure_signal: the product traverses the reparse root or reports generic success

FM-VIEW-MANIFEST.action: render the pinned root and child snapshots
FM-VIEW-MANIFEST.oracle: independent manifest comparison covers names, kinds and regular-file byte lengths
FM-VIEW-MANIFEST.failure_signal: missing, invented or mis-typed entry, or file size derived from renderer text

FM-VIEW-PARTIAL.action: make one controlled entry unreadable after proving the fixture precondition
FM-VIEW-PARTIAL.oracle: view completeness is partial with a typed observation error and is never rendered as an empty complete directory
FM-VIEW-PARTIAL.failure_signal: false empty, complete=true, silent omission or an attack that did not establish unreadability

FM-NAV-CHILD.action: navigate from the selected root into nav
FM-NAV-CHILD.oracle: a new exact nav snapshot is published
FM-NAV-CHILD.failure_signal: wrong directory, reused generation or path supplied by renderer

FM-NAV-PARENT.action: navigate from nav back to the selected root
FM-NAV-PARENT.oracle: a new exact root snapshot is published and navigation stops at that root
FM-NAV-PARENT.failure_signal: wrong parent, no new snapshot or navigation above root

FM-NAV-ESCAPE.action: try parent escape, absolute alias, ADS, reserved name, NUL and a created junction
FM-NAV-ESCAPE.oracle: each is refused before traversal and the current snapshot remains unchanged
FM-NAV-ESCAPE.failure_signal: any escape is followed, normalized into permission, or produces a new snapshot

FM-REFRESH-EXTERNAL.action: create and remove pinned entries outside the app, then invoke one GUI refresh
FM-REFRESH-EXTERNAL.oracle: one new snapshot is published and exactly reflects both external changes
FM-REFRESH-EXTERNAL.failure_signal: stale tree, more than one generation increment or fake live-sync before refresh

FM-REFRESH-STALE.action: retain a pre-refresh entry ID, replace the same-name file externally, refresh, then submit the old ID
FM-REFRESH-STALE.oracle: the old ID is refused and the replacement entry is untouched
FM-REFRESH-STALE.failure_signal: same-name substitution or an old ID mutates the new entry

FM-SELECT-SINGLE.action: select exactly one current entry ID
FM-SELECT-SINGLE.oracle: UI and main agree on that one ID and generation
FM-SELECT-SINGLE.failure_signal: name-only selection, extra selected entry or generation mismatch

FM-SELECT-MULTI.action: select multiple distinct current entry IDs
FM-SELECT-MULTI.oracle: UI and main agree on exact set membership; selection order is not a product claim
FM-SELECT-MULTI.failure_signal: single-selection fallback, dropped member or silent duplicate collapse

FM-SELECT-STALE.action: submit missing, duplicate, unknown and cross-generation entry IDs
FM-SELECT-STALE.oracle: the whole request is refused before mutation and every requested ID receives a typed refusal outcome
FM-SELECT-STALE.failure_signal: partial preflight mutation, deduplication or same-name substitution

FM-CREATE-DIRECTORY.action: create created-folder beneath the current directory
FM-CREATE-DIRECTORY.oracle: one directory appears and one new snapshot is published
FM-CREATE-DIRECTORY.failure_signal: wrong kind, wrong parent, duplicate creation or missing snapshot

FM-CREATE-REFUSE.action: try empty, duplicate, reserved, ADS, separator and NUL-containing names
FM-CREATE-REFUSE.oracle: each is refused, creates nothing and retains the snapshot
FM-CREATE-REFUSE.failure_signal: normalization into a different name, partial creation or generation advance

FM-RENAME.action: rename rename-me.txt to renamed.txt using its current entry ID
FM-RENAME.oracle: payload hash is unchanged, old path absent, new path present and one new snapshot published
FM-RENAME.failure_signal: payload change, duplicate paths, wrong entry or wrong generation

FM-RENAME-CONFLICT.action: rename to conflicts/existing-name.txt and submit a stale source ID
FM-RENAME-CONFLICT.oracle: both refuse without overwrite and retain the snapshot
FM-RENAME-CONFLICT.failure_signal: existing destination changes, stale source substitutes by name or snapshot advances

FM-COPY-FILE.action: copy copy-file.bin into dest-copy with one GUI batch command
FM-COPY-FILE.oracle: source and destination payloads are byte-identical and one new snapshot is published
FM-COPY-FILE.failure_signal: text re-encoding, source removal, extra mutation or test-side copying

FM-COPY-DIRECTORY.action: copy the entire copy-dir tree into dest-copy with one GUI batch command
FM-COPY-DIRECTORY.oracle: independent tree-and-byte oracle matches every nested file and empty directory
FM-COPY-DIRECTORY.failure_signal: flattened tree, omitted empty directory, per-entry test loop or payload drift

FM-COPY-PARTIAL.action: copy one valid and one controlled unreadable member in one multi-entry request
FM-COPY-PARTIAL.oracle: overall status is partial, every requested ID has an outcome, the valid copy is exact and the failed destination is absent
FM-COPY-PARTIAL.failure_signal: whole-batch success, whole-batch fiction, missing member outcome or silent partial data

FM-COPY-CONFLICT.oracle: request is refused without overwrite and the snapshot is unchanged
FM-COPY-CONFLICT.failure_signal: silent overwrite, auto-rename or generation advance

FM-MOVE-FILE.action: move move-file.txt into dest-move with one GUI batch command
FM-MOVE-FILE.oracle: destination hash matches, source is absent and one new snapshot is published
FM-MOVE-FILE.failure_signal: copy-with-source-left, payload drift or more than one published snapshot

FM-MOVE-DIRECTORY.action: move the entire move-dir tree into dest-move with one GUI batch command
FM-MOVE-DIRECTORY.oracle: destination tree is exact, original tree absent and empty/nested structure preserved
FM-MOVE-DIRECTORY.failure_signal: partial unreported move, flattened tree or test-side per-entry move loop

FM-MOVE-PARTIAL.action: move one valid and one controlled locked member in one request
FM-MOVE-PARTIAL.oracle: overall status is partial, successful source is absent, failed source remains, and every requested ID has an outcome
FM-MOVE-PARTIAL.failure_signal: all-success fiction, rollback fiction, missing member or wrong payload

FM-MOVE-CONFLICT.action: move to an existing destination and submit a stale destination-directory entry ID
FM-MOVE-CONFLICT.oracle: both are refused without overwrite, substitution or mutation
FM-MOVE-CONFLICT.failure_signal: silent overwrite, auto-rename, stale-ID substitution or generation advance

FM-TRASH-FILE.action: send trash-file.txt through the native Windows recycle operation
FM-TRASH-FILE.oracle: source leaves the root and independent native evidence identifies a recoverable recycle operation
FM-TRASH-FILE.failure_signal: permanent deletion, source disappearance alone or stubbed evidence reported as native

FM-TRASH-DIRECTORY.action: send the disposable trash-dir tree through the native Windows recycle operation
FM-TRASH-DIRECTORY.oracle: whole tree leaves the root and native recoverability evidence is recorded
FM-TRASH-DIRECTORY.failure_signal: permanent recursive delete, partial silent deletion or file-only implementation

FM-TRASH-REFUSE.action: submit stale, out-of-root and reparse entry IDs and force one controlled native failure
FM-TRASH-REFUSE.oracle: every refusal/failure is typed; zero-mutation results retain the snapshot; no permanent-delete fallback exists
FM-TRASH-REFUSE.failure_signal: target disappears, fallback deletion, wrong status or fabricated recovery evidence

system_acceptance_rows.FM-SYS-RESULT-UNION: exercise accepted, partial, refused and failed as four distinguishable overall statuses; refusal is policy/precondition and failure is admitted I/O with zero successes
system_acceptance_rows.FM-SYS-SNAPSHOT-SEQUENCE: every published snapshot advances generation exactly once regardless of refresh or mutation; generation is never interpreted as a mutation count
system_acceptance_rows.FM-SYS-SNAPSHOT-UNAVAILABLE: after at least one mutation succeeds, force the post-operation scan to fail and require snapshot state unavailable with typed code and last published generation rather than a fabricated current or unchanged snapshot
system_acceptance_rows.FM-SYS-ENTRY-ID-SCOPE: a new snapshot invalidates every prior opaque entry ID and name equality never revives one
system_acceptance_rows.FM-SYS-PATH-AUTHORITY: renderer never supplies an absolute or relative path or filesystem handle; main resolves root, entry IDs, destinations and single-segment names
system_acceptance_rows.FM-SYS-REPARSE: reparse entries may be shown but selected reparse roots, traversal and mutation are refused in v0; a resolved string is not cited as race-safe confinement
system_acceptance_rows.FM-SYS-NO-OVERWRITE: rename, copy and move never silently overwrite or auto-rename a destination
system_acceptance_rows.FM-SYS-ACTION-SHAPE: copy/move caps measure one specified GUI batch command over the pinned fixture subject, never a test-side per-entry loop or substituted injection route
system_acceptance_rows.FM-SYS-NO-PERMANENT-DELETE: no renderer, preload or main route exposes permanent delete in v0
system_acceptance_rows.FM-SYS-RELAUNCH-RESELECT: relaunch does not claim remembered-root persistence; acceptance explicitly selects the pinned root again

per_entry_meanings.refused: policy or a precondition rejected this entry before its mutation
per_entry_meanings.failed: this entry was admitted to execution and its I/O failed

operation_result.partial: at least one requested entry succeeded and at least one was refused or failed
operation_result.refused: no requested entry succeeded, no entry reached execution failure, and policy or preconditions refused the request or every member before mutation
operation_result.failed: no requested entry succeeded and at least one admitted entry reached execution failure; other entries may have been refused

snapshot.current: contains the newly published snapshot after observation succeeds
snapshot.unchanged: contains the exact prior snapshot when no mutation occurred and no new snapshot was published
snapshot.unavailable: contains no fabricated snapshot; reports last_published_generation and a typed observation code

reparse.later_revision_requires: handle-based or equivalently evidenced confinement before any in-root reparse permission

deferred_capabilities.rationale: Electron and the Windows default-application route do not promise a new child PID and may reuse an existing process. A test helper would measure a different operation.
deferred_capabilities.revisit_gate: a bounded native acceptance can identify ownership and clean only processes it launched without changing the default-application operation

fixture_contract.root_location: fresh D-drive scratch directory created per run; never a user folder

dynamic_subjects.precondition: create a junction inside the root targeting a disposable directory outside it
dynamic_subjects.did_not_apply: acceptance failure, not a caught attack

dynamic_subjects.precondition: hold a process-owned Windows handle that independently proves the intended mutation is denied
dynamic_subjects.cleanup: close only that exact handle/process in finally

dynamic_subjects.precondition: deny enumeration on one disposable child and prove denial before the view action
dynamic_subjects.cleanup: restore that exact child ACL in finally

timing_policy.purpose: hang detection only; no fast, responsive or cross-machine latency verdict

bounded_actions.subject: copy-dir exact manifest subtree
bounded_actions.timer_start: renderer dispatch of the user command
bounded_actions.timer_stop: overall result and snapshot state are rendered
bounded_actions.forbidden_substitution: test-side per-entry loop, pre-copy, internal service call or different fixture

bounded_actions.subject: move-dir exact manifest subtree
bounded_actions.timer_start: renderer dispatch of the user command
bounded_actions.timer_stop: overall result and snapshot state are rendered
bounded_actions.forbidden_substitution: test-side per-entry loop, pre-move, internal service call or different fixture

comparator.scope: one conventional main-process filesystem operation-core artifact; not a second GUI product
comparator.same_subject: same main-process operation subset, pinned fixture manifest, operation vectors and independent tree-and-byte oracle
comparator.topology: ordinary imperative handlers with no predeclared MSSP set decomposition
comparator.quantitative_claim_gate: implementation size, defect, blast-radius or verification-effort comparisons require the executable comparator and the same bounded protocol; otherwise each is NotMeasured

topology.what_is_preregistered: product, capability, cross-cutting contract, fixture, evidence and comparator boundaries only
topology.forbidden_default: do not copy App-1 module topology, document capabilities or encoding boundaries into App 2
topology.next_step: three architects derive and attest a separate App-2 MSSP core after this preregistration survives attack

membership.role_change: any reviewer who edits later product code becomes a builder for that exact commit and cannot supply the only independent acceptance

general: denominator deletion or reclassification after results
foundation stuffing and cheap-share expensive-adaptation laundering
author tests accepted as independent evidence
slice_specific: generation is misread as a mutation counter instead of snapshot identity
partial mutation plus unavailable post-operation scan is forced into a fabricated current or unchanged snapshot
policy refusal and admitted execution failure collapse into one status
old snapshot ID mutates a same-name replacement
reparse string containment is cited as race-safe authority
one batch result omits a requested entry or flattens partial failure
copy or move timing measures a test-side loop or different subject
file-only behavior is reported as directory support
source disappearance is reported as Recycle Bin recoverability
permanent delete is exposed as a fallback

stop_boundary: This artifact authorizes only preregistration review. No App-2 product record or production code begins until the exact preregistration is green under its own verifier and drills, Elenchos completes first independent attack, Pragma completes denominator/acceptance-row attack, and all three architects approve the exact digest. Product implementation additionally requires a separately agreed App-2 MSSP core, work package, pinned fixture materialization and acceptance ownership. No provider call, main merge, release, deployment, publication or MSSP method adoption is authorized here.
